raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

A request to `/v1/messages` or `/v1/messages/count_tokens` whose `tools[*].type` is not a string (e.g. `["web_search_2025"]` or `true`) returns `500 Internal Server Error` as **text/plain**, instead of the Anthropic-style 400 JSON error that every other malformed field gets. Clients that parse the error body fail twice. The engine itself stays healthy.

Cause: `_tool_discriminator` (the `Discriminator` callable on the `AnthropicTool` union) calls `t.startswith(...)` on the tag. A non-string tag raises `AttributeError` *inside the discriminator*; pydantic surfaces that as a bare exception rather than a `ValidationError`, so FastAPI's `RequestValidationError` handler never runs and Starlette emits its default 500.

```
File ".../sglang/srt/entrypoints/anthropic/protocol.py", in _tool_discriminator
    if t.startswith("web_search_"):
AttributeError: 'list' object has no attribute 'startswith'
```

## Modifications

- `protocol.py`: a non-string tag selects the `custom` variant, so `AnthropicCustomTool.type: Optional[Literal["custom"]]` rejects it as a normal `ValidationError` at `tools.N.type`. The existing `/v1/messages*` handler then returns `400 {"type":"error","error":{"type":"invalid_request_error","message":"tools.0.custom.type: Input should be 'custom'"}}`. String tags take exactly the same path as before. (Raising from the discriminator is not an option; that is the bug.)
- `test/registered/unit/entrypoints/anthropic/test_serving.py`: `test_non_string_tool_type_is_a_validation_error` (list / bool / int / dict, asserts the error loc names `tools`, the index and `type`), the same for `AnthropicCountTokensRequest`, and `test_string_tool_types_still_select_their_variant` (absent, `custom`, `web_search_*`, `computer_*`, `bash_*`, `text_editor_*`).

## Accuracy Tests

Not applicable (request validation only).

## Benchmarking and Profiling

Not applicable.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Code Formatting with Pre-Commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-formatting-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests as outlined in the [Running Unit Tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#running-unit-tests-adding-to-ci).
- [x] Update documentation / docstrings / example tutorials as needed, according to [Writing Documentation](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#writing-documentation).
- [x] Provide throughput / latency benchmark results and accuracy evaluation results as needed, according to [Benchmark and Profiling](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/benchmark_and_profiling.html) and [Accuracy Results](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#accuracy-results).
- [x] For reviewers: If you haven't made any contributions to this PR and are only assisting with merging the main branch, please remove yourself as a co-author when merging.
- [x] Please feel free to join our Slack channel at https://slack.sglang.io to discuss your PR.

Verified against a live server (SGLang 0.5.21, one GPU): before, both endpoints answered `500 text/plain` for `type=[...]` and `type=true`; after, `400 application/json` with the envelope above; `"custom"` and valid server-tool types unchanged (200). The three new tests fail on `main` (5 subtests) and pass with this change; the whole file passes (71 tests).

```
$ PYTHONPATH=. python p45653.py   # POST /v1/messages on a bare FastAPI app taking AnthropicMessagesRequest, pydantic 2.14.1

["web_search_2025"]   500 text/plain                   422 ['body','tools',0,'custom','type'] Input should be 'custom'   422 ['body','tools',0] Unable to extract tag using discriminator _tool_discriminator()
True, 123, {"x": 1}   500 text/plain                   same as above                                         same as above
# not run: sglang's own handler that maps this to the Anthropic 400 envelope, and test_serving.py
# (it needs the full sglang install); protocol.py ran from the PR tree with a stub sglang.utils
```

@@ -211,6 +211,14 @@ def _tool_discriminator(v) -> str:
         t = getattr(v, "type", None)
     if not t or t == "custom":
         return "custom"
+    if not isinstance(t, str):
+        # A non-string tag (list, bool, int, ...) is a client error. Returning
+        # a tag here is the only way to surface it as a pydantic
+        # ValidationError (``tools.N.type: Input should be 'custom'``) that
+        # FastAPI maps to the Anthropic 400 envelope. Raising from a
+        # discriminator escapes validation as a bare exception and the
+        # client gets a plain-text HTTP 500 (NVBug 6917691).
+        return "custom"
     if t.startswith("web_search_"):
         return "web_search"
     if t.startswith("computer_"):

@@ -11,10 +11,17 @@

 from fastapi.responses import JSONResponse  # noqa: E402
 from jinja2 import Environment  # noqa: E402
+from pydantic import ValidationError  # noqa: E402
 
 from sglang.srt.entrypoints.anthropic.protocol import (  # noqa: E402
+    AnthropicBashTool,

+    AnthropicWebSearchTool,
 )
 from sglang.srt.entrypoints.anthropic.serving import AnthropicServing  # noqa: E402
 from sglang.srt.entrypoints.openai.protocol import (  # noqa: E402
@@ -526,6 +533,88 @@ def test_custom_tool_without_schema_is_rejected(self):
                 }
             )
 
+    def test_non_string_tool_type_is_a_validation_error(self):
+        # NVBug 6917691: a list/bool/int ``tools[*].type`` used to escape the
+        # discriminated union as a bare AttributeError (``t.startswith``) in
+        # _tool_discriminator, so FastAPI never saw a RequestValidationError
+        # and the client got a plain-text HTTP 500. It must be a pydantic
+        # ValidationError that names the field.
+        for bad_type in (["web_search_2025"], True, 123, {"x": 1}):
+            with self.subTest(tool_type=bad_type):
+                with self.assertRaises(ValidationError) as caught:
+                    AnthropicMessagesRequest.model_validate(
+                        {
+                            "model": "test-model",
+                            "max_tokens": 16,
+                            "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "hi"}],
+                            "tools": [
+                                {
+                                    "name": "demo",
+                                    "description": "Demo tool",
+                                    "input_schema": {
+                                        "type": "object",
+                                        "properties": {},
+                                    },
+                                    "type": bad_type,
+                                }
+                            ],
+                        }
+                    )
+                # The error must point the client at tools[0].type.
+                locs = [err["loc"] for err in caught.exception.errors()]
+                self.assertTrue(
+                    any(("tools", 0) == loc[:2] and loc[-1] == "type" for loc in locs),
+                    locs,
+                )
+
+    def test_non_string_tool_type_is_a_validation_error_count_tokens(self):
+        with self.assertRaises(ValidationError):
+            AnthropicCountTokensRequest.model_validate(
+                {
+                    "model": "test-model",
+                    "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "hi"}],
+                    "tools": [
+                        {
+                            "name": "demo",
+                            "input_schema": {"type": "object"},
+                            "type": True,
+                        }
+                    ],
+                }
+            )
+
+    def test_string_tool_types_still_select_their_variant(self):
+        cases = {
+            None: AnthropicCustomTool,
+            "custom": AnthropicCustomTool,
+            "web_search_20250305": AnthropicWebSearchTool,
+            "computer_20250124": AnthropicComputerTool,
+            "bash_20250124": AnthropicBashTool,
+            "text_editor_20250124": AnthropicTextEditorTool,
+        }
+        names = {
+            AnthropicWebSearchTool: "web_search",
+            AnthropicComputerTool: "computer",
+            AnthropicBashTool: "bash",
+            AnthropicTextEditorTool: "str_replace_based_edit_tool",
+        }
+        for tool_type, expected in cases.items():
+            with self.subTest(tool_type=tool_type):
+                tool = {"name": names.get(expected, "demo")}
+                if expected is AnthropicCustomTool:
+                    tool["input_schema"] = {"type": "object"}
+                if tool_type is not None:
+                    tool["type"] = tool_type
+                request = AnthropicMessagesRequest.model_validate(
+                    {
+                        "model": "test-model",
+                        "max_tokens": 16,
+                        "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "hi"}],
+                        "tools": [tool],
+                    }
+                )
+                self.assertIsInstance(request.tools[0], expected)
+
